from pathlib import Path
p = Path\('/Users/johnnyzhang/extra_gushi/gushiTaro/src/pages/index.jsx'\)
text = p.read_text\(\)
# Fix over-indented content inside dailyPoem card
import re
# Pattern: lines that start with too many tabs inside the dailyPoem card
# Specifically, within <View className='dailyPoem-header'> and <View className='dailyPoem-body'>
# The children are indented with 6 tabs but should be 5 tabs \(same level as the View\)

# Let's just fix the specific section
lines = text.splitlines\(\)
out = []
in_section = False
for line in lines:
    if "<View className='dailyPoem-header'>" in line:
        in_section = True
        out.append\(line\)
        continue
    if in_section and "</Navigator>" in line:
        in_section = False
        out.append\(line\)
        continue
    if in_section:
        # reduce leading tabs by one if there are 6 leading tabs
        if line.startswith\('\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t\\t'\):
            out.append\(line[1:]\)
        else:
            out.append\(line\)
    else:
        out.append\(line\)

p.write_text\('\\n'.join\(out\)\)
print\('done'\)
PY)
